title: FW: School Letter Timing, Spanish Gap, and La Voz del Valle Call

fields.to: Public Information Officer; Public Health Director; Nurse Manager
fields.subject: FW: RE: approved letter + phone message from La Voz del Valle (live at 13:00)
fields.body:
PIO, Director, Nurse Manager,

Phone message below came in on the main line (555-0100) at 12:02. I'm also forwarding the district nurse coordinator's 11:56 email underneath. She asked that all three of you see it.

PHONE MESSAGE: Mon 10/12/2026, 12:02
For: PIO
Caller: Host of "La Voz del Valle," Spanish-language call-in show (lavozdelvalle.example), 555-0129
Message: "Our 13:00 show is all callers asking about the supper. Somebody on the air said 'el cáterer está cerrado y la ensalada tiene salmonela.' Can MCHD put someone on in Spanish, or send me something in Spanish I can read? I go live in one hour."
Deadline: 13:00 live. He asked for a call back before then.

— Front Desk

-----Original Message-----
From: Margo Teller, RN <nursecoordinator@fenwickschools.example>
Sent: Monday, October 12, 2026 11:56 AM
To: MCHD Public Information Officer
Cc: MCHD Public Health Director; MCHD Nurse Manager
Subject: RE: approved letter

We're waiting on your approved text. Dr. Anselm Voss says he will drop "bad coleslaw" and use your numbers once he has it.

Problem: our translator says the Spanish version will take four hours, so 16:00 at the earliest. Our template has no Spanish version, and about 11 percent of our students come from Spanish-speaking homes. The superintendent still wants the English letter out at 13:00 because parents are calling.

Margo Teller, RN
District Nurse Coordinator
Fenwick Community School District | 555-0183
fields.signature:
MCHD Front Desk
Marlow County Health Department | Main 555-0100 | Fax 555-0199

instructorNote: This page adds pressure on equal access and timing. Watch whether the PIO, with the Director's sign-off, decides how to release the letter: hold it, or send English at 13:00 with a line saying Spanish follows by 16:00 and pointing to a Spanish hotline option. Also check that the letter uses exactly the count of 38 as of 11:45 and that La Voz del Valle gets only approved facts in Spanish, with no cause, no food and no closure confirmed.
